What to find: Technical means for integrating the model (usage instructions, APIs, serving frameworks, prompt/chat format).
Card sections that often contain it: How to Use, Quickstart, Usage, Deployment

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Use the chat template with the system prompt for inference; append `<think>` to force thinking or `<nothink>` to force non-thinking. Requires torch >= 2.7.1, transformers >= 4.57.1, and vllm >= 0.15.2 (only if using vLLM). Hosting on a vLLM server with bf16 precision is recommended.
quotes: Given the nature of the training data, always use chat template and system prompt for inference.
To force a thinking response, append the `<think>` token to the generation template:
To force a non-thinking response, append the `<nothink>` token to the generation template:
It is recommended that users host Phi-4-Reasoning-Vision-15B on a vLLM server using bf16 precision.
